description: JSONPath subset vectors shared by the server's data service (DATA-009, JsonPath/JsonTree) and the client's JSON reader (DATA-004). Documents are JSON text so number source text survives. `matches` lists every match as compact JSON (no whitespace, members in source order, numbers as their source text, strings escaping only quote, backslash and control characters); `error` names the refusal kind. In `records`, each record maps a requested path to its text value: strings unquoted, numbers as source text, booleans true/false, null and missing absent, objects and arrays compact JSON, indefinite paths a compact JSON array of their matches. See docs/_includes/automation/data-merge.adoc, Pagination engine and extraction.

records.name: records path to an array reads its elements
empty records path reads the root array
a root object is one record
nested objects and arrays render as compact JSON
indefinite paths render their matches as an array
indefinite path keeps nulls inside its array
a records path matching nothing yields no records
